body.text: Loadout Changer on [Elite](/products/mw4-cheats/elite/) and the standalone [Unlock All product](/products/mw4-cheats/unlock-all/) let you preview outfits, appearances, and exclusive sets locally in Modern Warfare.
Loadout Changer overview

Loadout Changer on [Elite](/products/mw4-cheats/elite/) and the standalone [Unlock All product](/products/mw4-cheats/unlock-all/) let you preview outfits, appearances, and exclusive sets locally in Modern Warfare.
Effects are client-side—lobby teammates see your real inventory; you see the cosmetic swap on your screen.
Unlock All vs Elite Loadout Changer
Unlock All is cosmetic-only—browse, favorite, export loadouts. Elite bundles Loadout Changer with aimbot, ESP wallhack, and bots.
Pick Unlock All if you only want visuals; pick Elite if you Ranked with full automation. Feature overview: [cheats features guide](/blog/mw4-cheats-features-guide/).
Browse and preview workflow
Open the Loadout Changer tab in your portal, search player name, select outfit or exclusive set, apply to local client. Use effect customizer for particle intensity.
Save favorites per player for quick swap before demo sessions or content recording. Loadouts export for backup across PCs via cloud sync on Elite.
Stream and content notes
Local skins appear on your display—stream capture may still show them depending on setup. Enable [stream-proof mode](/blog/mw4-stream-proof-setup/) for ESP and script overlays.
Test cosmetic capture separately in a 30-second OBS clip before long streams. Radar hack camera does not affect skin particles.
anti-cheat and safety
Cosmetic modules carry the same third-party risk as any modern warfare cheat—read buymw4cheats.com status before use. Unlock All does not grant loadout menu items; it only changes local preview.
No marketplace or trade impact—cosmetics are visual-only on your client. Pair with [anti-cheat checklist](/blog/ricochet-patch-day-checklist/) after patches.
Ranked with cosmetics
Elite operators run Loadout Changer alongside aimbot—cosmetic tab separate from Ranked preset. Do not swap skins mid-fight; apply in fountain or strategy screen.
Compare [Elite tier guide](/blog/mw4-elite-tier-guide/) if buying Elite primarily for Loadout Changer plus bots.
